question: Which of the following is a right bank tributary of the Ganga?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Son.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Son River**

 
 
• **​****Son** is a right bank tributary of the **Ganga**.
 
• **Central India** is home to the perennial Son River. It starts near **Amarkantak Hill** in the **Chhattisgarh **district of **Gaurela-Pendra-Marwahi**, and eventually, it joins the **Ganges River** close to Patna, Bihar.
 
• After the** Yamuna River**, the Sone River is the Ganges' second-largest tributary in the south.
